main_text.p: נפץ Ch.& Syr. Spargere, dispergere: Fundere, effundere, profundere: Exprimere, excutere, elidere: Contundere, comminuere cum dispersione. Pahel נפץ Idem. Ithpahel אתנפץ Excuti, excutere se.

נפק Ch. & Syr. Exire, egredi, prodire, procedere. Syriacè cum nomine [illegible, ~6 letters] est Defendere, defensionem habere, defensione uti, Causam dicere, excusare, quomodo respondet Graeco ἀπολογέομαι, Lucae 12.11.& 21.14. Act.19.33.& 24.10. 25.8.& 26.1.2.24. ad Rom.2.15. 2.ad Cor.12.19. Aphel אפיק, & הנפק Exire, egredi facere, educere, producere, proferre, efferre, ejicere, emittere: Item Syr. Exponere, expendere, impedere, sumptus facere, Mar. 5.26. 2.ad Corinth.12.15. Sic Ch. דמפקין סלעא Qui expendunt siclum, Deut.1.12.in Jon. Ithpah. אתפק Educi, produci.
נפק Ch.Exiens, egrediens: נפק בר Egrediens foras, Meritorius, Cynoedus, Deut.23.17.in Targ.Hierosol.Foemin. ברא נפקת נפקת Egrediens, discurrens, vaga, vagatrix, meretrix, scortum. Plur. נפקת ברא.
נפקתא, נפקא Ch. Sumptus, impensae, expensae.
נפקתא Ch.Projectura, prominens edificii pars, 1.Regum 6.6. Regia נפקתא.
אפוקא Ch. Productio, productum, prolatum, prolatio. Plur. לאפוקי בר זרעא Productiones fementis, Levit. 26.5. Item Talm. Contra; unde in Targum לאפוקי תרי Contra duos, Deuter.1.12. Jon.
אפקות Ch. Idem. אפקות ספותהא Prolatio labiorum ejus, Num.30.13.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek are set from the scan and may contain small errors in pointing. The Syriac after "cum nomine" is too faint to read and is marked illegible. Faint show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
